newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croat convicted for paedophilic images on Internet.
newsitem.headline: Croat convicted for paedophilic images on Internet.

text.p: A 21-year-old Croatian student was given a suspended jail sentence for creating a child sex Internet web site, the daily Vecernji List said on Saturday.
The man, identified only as Boris T, was charged with displaying paedophilic pictures on the site he created on his home and university computers.
The prosecutor at the county court in Karlovac, south of Zagreb, planned to appeal against the suspended sentence.

The newspaper said Croatian police were alerted by Norwegian police and found the pornographic files in Boris T.'s home computer and another he used at the faculty of electrical engineering and computer science at Zagreb University.
Boris T., whose Internet nickname was Tookey, said he created the website as a protest against censorship on the Internet.
